trendline_timing_rule: Created at second anchor confirmation; dashed segment is retrospective. Stop at first crossing beyond tolerance.
trendline_time_axis: Elapsed minutes, including gaps; no extrapolation beyond observed history.
timing_rule: At completed bar t, test pivot t-window using only bars <= t.
gap_policy: No filling; window counts observations, including across gaps/sessions.

swing_method.label: Traditional TA
swing_method.timing_rule: At completed bar t, test pivot t-window using only bars <= t.

warnings: VWAP unavailable after missing volume within its anchor period; no substitute volume is used.
indicators.timing: Available at the current completed bar; all windows use past/current observations only.
indicators.warmup: Unavailable values are JSON null / CSV blank; no backward filling.
indicators.ema_seed: SMA of first period values; alpha=2/(period+1).
indicators.rsi: Wilder smoothing; flat gain/loss yields 50; gain-only 100, loss-only 0.
indicators.atr: First true range is High-Low; SMA seed then Wilder smoothing.
indicators.cci: Typical price HLC3; 0.015 scaling; mean absolute deviation; flat window yields 0.
indicators.vwap: HLC3 weighted by actual volume; session means input calendar date, not an exchange calendar.

breakouts.scope: All accepted Close trendlines; one first-break event per line ID
breakouts.interpretation: Confirmed can later fail. No failure within the window is not proof of future continuation. Counts are per line, not independent trades.

trading.entry_assumption: Idealised confirmation-Close fill; not a guaranteed executable price. Protection begins on the next bar.
trading.exit_assumption: Fixed ATR stop and reward/risk target. Gap stop at Open; target at limit. Both intrabar levels: stop first.
trading.timestamp_convention: Timestamps identify input bars; entry_phase/exit_phase distinguish Open, Close and unknown intrabar time.
trading.capital_rule: One position, fixed quantity; entry notional plus entry fee must fit available equity; no leverage.
trading.costs_assumption: Configured commission/slippage; short borrow charged on entry notional by elapsed time using actual/365. Zero rates assume zero cost.
trading.interpretation: Historical simulation, not live order execution. An open position is marked at the cutoff, not forcibly closed.
